steps.title: Account Sync
steps.content: Local Folders need Sync my settings first. Open Account Sync to connect Google Drive or OneDrive for settings sync.

steps.title: Connect a cloud account
steps.content: Click Connect next to Google Drive or OneDrive. You only need Sync my settings to unlock Local Folders—you can turn on Sync my files later.

steps.title: Uncheck Sync my files
steps.content: *Uncheck* the **Sync my files** checkbox to prevent syncing your files to the cloud, since you will be using Local Folders instead.

steps.title: Finish sign-in
steps.content: Connect with Sync my settings enabled, then return to Local Folders to install the Watchman desktop client.
